design_system.name: Cyber-Linguist
design_system.description: A dark, futuristic, and focused interface for mastering pronunciation. Uses deep blacks, glowing neons, and precise typography to create a 'pro-tool' feel.

grid.hero: flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh] text-center space-y-8

components.name: PronunciationCard
components.description: The main interaction area. Displays the text to read and handles recording logic.
components.styles: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border border-border shadow-sm p-8 flex flex-col items-center gap-6 relative overflow-hidden
features: Large typography for the target sentence
Visual feedback (Green/Red highlights) on individual words

components.name: RecordingButton
components.description: A prominent, circular button for toggling recording.
components.styles: w-20 h-20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg

components.name: FeedbackPanel
components.description: Displays detailed analysis after recording stops.
components.styles: bg-zinc-900/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-6 w-full max-w-2xl mt-8
features: Score display (Circle progress or huge number)
List of mispronounced words with 'Play Correct' buttons

components.name: HistoryGrid
components.description: A Bento-grid style layout for past attempts.
components.item_style: bg-card hover:bg-accent/50 transition-colors rounded-lg p-4 border border-border flex flex-col gap-2

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-to-background contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1. Use lighter grays (Zinc-300/400) for secondary text, not dark grays.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-cyan-500 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (Mic, Play) must have aria-label attributes.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Ensure the recording can be toggled via Spacebar or Enter when focused.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (Mic, Play, Pause, RefreshCw, Trophy, History, Activity).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts link to the <head> of public/index.html immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (cyan-500, zinc-950, etc.) and font families (Space Grotesk, Inter).
3. DARK MODE DEFAULT: Ensure the app defaults to dark mode. The HTML tag should have 'class="dark"' or logic to apply it.
4. NO GRADIENT TEXT ON INPUTS: Ensure input fields have solid text colors for readability.
5. USE LUCIDE ICONS: Import icons from 'lucide-react'. Do not use emojis for UI controls.
6. ERROR HANDLING: If Web Speech API is not supported (e.g., some browsers), show a graceful fallback or alert.
7. MICRO-INTERACTIONS: Add 'transform active:scale-95' to all buttons for a tactile feel.
8. PREVENT LAYOUT SHIFT: Reserve space for the feedback panel so the UI doesn't jump when it appears.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: - Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
- Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
- Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
- Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
- You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
- You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
- Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
- NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
- Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
- Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
- Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
